description:
The published rate-limit tiers and enforcement contract (FREE read).

Limits bind to resolved identity -- the verified pairing token on
plugin-v1/agent-v1, the client IP on anonymous surfaces -- so rotating
caller_id never resets a bucket. Value-bearing tools additionally consume
a separate lower bucket. Exhausted callers get a RATE_LIMITED error
envelope with retry_after_seconds; plugin-v1/agent-v1 tools/call also
answers HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
name: get_rate_limits
